name: Ogres
background:
Ogres are a heavy-set species of humanoids that stand a head above most Humans. Few in number, their sheer size makes them very powerful, allowing them to soak up attacks and crush their foes. 

In ancient times, the Ogres’ knowledge of magic and Voidgates brought them wealth and prosperity that rivalled any Kingdom in eastern Tyria. However, these Voidgates began to tear into the fabric of other planes, causing the Shadow Stalkers to pour into their lands. The surviving Ogres have been driven into exile, forced to abandon their ancient homes, wealth and prosperity for life on the steppes.
backgroundFull:
The Ogres come from a land to the west of Tyria, where they founded several kingdoms which came to dominate the region. Here, the Ogres discovered many ancient Voidgates and relics, which allowed them to develop many schools of magic, and grow quite wealthy. The Ogre Shamans were perhaps the most notable of these schools, as they learnt to control and even create new Voidgates. Thanks to the Shamans’ abilities, Ogres could travel anywhere in their realms in an instant, living lives of luxury and leisure, as they could acquire whatever their hearts and stomachs desired. 

Soon, the Shamans looked beyond their homelands, to the wealth of other planes. Kings sent traders and armies to seek treasures unattainable on Tyria. While many returned with great wealth, some individuals and even whole caravans disappeared as they went through the Voidgates, never arriving at their destination. As larger groups were targeted, survivors began to return. They spoke of cruel beings who hunted them through the void, which they called Shadow Stalkers, but their stories were dismissed as hallucinations or anomalies. Ogres refused to heed these warning signs, however, as their insatiable desire drove them to seek ever more wealth through the Voidgates.

It was only when the Voidgates to their realm suddenly stopped working that the Ogres came to realise that something terrible had happened: the Shadow Stalkers had come to Tyria. Soon, Shadow Stalkers poured through every gate which the Ogre Shamans had created, destroying their cities. With Shadow Stalkers lurking in every corner of their land, most Ogres abandoned their old homes. The Shadow Stalkers continued to hunt them, seeking to kill the Ogre Shamans to reopen the Voidgates. 

Now the Ogres have come to eastern Tyria in search of a new home. Some Ogres have come as conquerors, carving out petty Kingdoms by attacking the remote western territories of the Empire and its neighbours. Others travel further as traders and mercenaries, selling wares, spells and services in hopes of building a new life. 

How will you restore the lost prosperity of your people?

specialRules.name: Unwieldy
specialRules.description: Strikes last when charging.

specialRules.name: Great Sergeant
specialRules.description: This model gets AP(+2) when attacking.

specialRules.name: Sergeant
specialRules.description: This model gets AP(+1) when attacking.

specialRules.name: Armor
specialRules.description: Counts as having Defense X+.

specialRules.name: Fortified
specialRules.description: When units where most models have this rule take hits, those hits count as having AP(-1), to a min. of AP(0).

specialRules.name: Destroyer
specialRules.description: When this model attacks enemies that already finished an activation this round, unmodified results of 1 to block hits from weapons deal 1 extra wound.

specialRules.name: Bravery Aura
specialRules.description: This model and its unit get +1 to Morale Test rolls.

specialRules.name: Piercing Feat
specialRules.description: Once per game, when this unit attacks, you may use this rule so that the weapons of all models with this rule in it get AP(+1).

specialRules.name: Caster Group
specialRules.description: Pick one model with this rule in this unit to have Caster(X), where X is the total number of models with this rule in this unit. If the model is killed, pick another to be the new caster, and transfer all spell tokens to it. The caster loses all unspent spell tokens at the end of the round.

specialRules.name: Fortified Aura
specialRules.description: This model and its unit get Fortified.

specialRules.name: Melee Evasion
specialRules.description: Enemies get -1 to hit rolls in melee when attacking units where most models have this rule.

specialRules.name: Ravage
specialRules.description: Once per round, when it’s this model’s turn to strike in melee, roll X dice before attacking, unless this unit is Fatigued. For each 6+ the target takes one wound.

specialRules.name: Unpredictable Fighter Aura
specialRules.description: This model and its unit get Unpredictable Fighter.

specialRules.name: Unstoppable when Shooting Aura
specialRules.description: This model and its unit get Unstoppable when shooting.

specialRules.name: Unwieldy Debuff
specialRules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which gets Unwieldy in melee once (next time the effect would apply).

specialRules.name: Melee Evasion Buff
specialRules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly unit within 12", which gets Melee Evasion once (next time the effect would apply).

specialRules.name: Heavy Impact
specialRules.description: Counts as having Impact(X) with hits that have AP(1).

specialRules.name: Enhanced Destroyer
specialRules.description: If this model has Destroyer, enemies always take wounds on unmodified results of 1 to block from Destroyer (instead of only when attacking enemies that already finished an activation).

specialRules.name: Great Musician
specialRules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly unit within 12", which moves +1" when using move actions once (next time the effect would apply).

specialRules.name: Spell Resistance
specialRules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule takes wounds, roll one die for each. On a 6+ it is ignored. If the wounds were from a spell, then they are ignored on a 2+ instead.

specialRules.name: Melee Slayer
specialRules.description: When charging, this model's weapons get AP(+2) if most models in the target have Tough(3) or higher.

specialRules.name: Takedown Strike
specialRules.description: Once per game, when it's this model's turn to strike in melee, it may make X attacks at Quality 2+ with AP(2), Deadly(3), and Takedown.

specialRules.name: Fragment
specialRules.description: When attacking units where most models have Defense 4+ to Defense 6+, the target must re-roll successful unmodified Defense results of 4-6.

specialRules.name: Great Banner
specialRules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly unit within 12", which gets +1 to Morale Test rolls triggered by shooting/melee once (next time the effect would apply).

specialRules.name: Enhanced Destroyer Aura
specialRules.description: This model and its unit get Enhanced Destroyer.

specialRules.name: Violent
specialRules.description: When this model attacks enemies that already finished an activation this round, unmodified results of 1 to block hits from weapons deal 1 extra wound.

specialRules.name: Enhanced Violent
specialRules.description: If this model has Violent, enemies always take wounds on unmodified results of 1 to block from Violent (instead of only when attacking enemies that already finished an activation).

specialRules.name: AP
specialRules.description: Targets get -X to Defense rolls when blocking hits.

specialRules.name: Defense
specialRules.description: This model gets +X to Defense rolls.

specialRules.name: Caster
specialRules.description: Gets X spell tokens at the start of each round, but can’t have more than 6 at once. Once per activation, before attacking, spend as many tokens as the spell’s value to try casting one or more spells (only one try per spell). Pick a target and roll one die, and on 4+ resolve the spell’s effect. Models within 18” of the Caster may spend any number of spell tokens at the same time before rolling to give the Caster +1/-1 to the roll per token.

specialRules.name: Unpredictable
specialRules.description: When attacking, roll one die and apply one effect to all models with this rule: on a 1-3 they get AP(+1), and on a 4-6 they get +1 to hit rolls instead.

specialRules.name: Unpredictable Fighter
specialRules.description: When in melee, roll one die and apply one effect to all models with this rule: on a 1-3 they get AP(+1), and on a 4-6 they get +1 to hit rolls instead.

specialRules.name: Unstoppable
specialRules.description: Ignores Regeneration, and ignores all negative modifiers to this weapon which are not from this model's special rules.

specialRules.name: Impact
specialRules.description: When charging, before either unit attacks, models in the two front rows roll X dice, unless this unit is Fatigued. For each 2+ the target takes 1 hit.

specialRules.name: Tough
specialRules.description: This model must take X wounds before being killed. If a model with Tough joins a unit without it, then it is removed last when the unit takes wounds. You must continue to put wounds on the Tough model with most wounds in the unit until it is killed, before starting to put them on the next Tough model (Heroes must be assigned wounds last, even if already wounded).

specialRules.name: Takedown
specialRules.description: This model may pick any model in the target unit as its individual target for this weapon's attacks, which is resolved as if it was a unit of [1]. Takedown attacks must be resolved before other weapons.

specialRules.name: Deadly
specialRules.description: Assign each wound to one model, and multiply it by X. Hits from Deadly must be resolved first, and these wounds don’t carry over to other models if the original target is killed.
